notes.title: 🎉 Big Update Before Release
notes.notes: [p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601427/876975dfafb1eba152e3517e6fc9e6897dd96b16.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601427/fdf5f423894cc88a5c1e250c7f3ccd07221e25df.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601427/6e8f722195f96f8bf983a8532fe010bcd13b9943.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601427/7521d18ac3633b9eca962ce2f10afb1c5c134c8a.png"][/img][/carousel][p]Here’s what’s new in this pre-release milestone:[/p][p]👍 Post-Run Stat Upgrades[/p][p]You can now permanently upgrade your base stats after each run. Build your own meta-progression path and grow stronger with every attempt.[/p][p]♻️ Recycle Unused Gear[/p][p]Too much junk in your inventory? Recycle equipment to gain resources and keep your loadout clean and efficient.[/p][p]🍀 Lucky Affixes[/p][p]Some gear now rolls with new Luck-based tags — hunt for that perfect drop with extra bonuses or rare effects.[/p][p]🔁 Item Trading[/p][p]Found something you don’t need? Trade it with a merchant and roll for something more useful — maybe even legendary![/p][p]⚔️ Mixed Randomized Waves[/p][p]The battlefield just got wilder. Enemy waves now include a mix of unit types, random patterns, and unpredictable chaos. Adapt or get overrun![/p][p]This is our last major update before release — and it's your chance to dive in, test everything, and help shape the final version![/p][p]🫶🏻 Wishlist Village Defenders now![/p][p]Let’s get ready to defend — and evolve.[/p]
